rule_comparison.note: per organization, the proportion of its quality (below-threshold) proposals with complete votes approved under four of four minus the proportion approved under one of four, mean over organizations with a 95% interval; both rules read the same four votes, so the difference is never positive: a benchmark, not a hypothesis
